title: Statues of Jealous Victory: Threshold Sign
description: Statues of Jealous Victory unfolds across mirror-victory hall with living statue lanes and polished judgment floors, pushing a 5-Titan Olympian squad to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Statues of Jealous Victory: Threshold Sign advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
